# SovRing-Labs

> SovRing-Labs is one person's open research lab building AI that runs on the computers people already own.

Start: read README.md (60 seconds), then QUICKSTART.md (5 minutes: paste-to-assistant or 3 commands). `install.sh` clones the repos you choose and runs each quick test; `.mcp/server.py` is a stdio MCP server (Python, no dependencies) with tools explain, check_readiness, setup_steps, fetch_repo, quick_test, list_tests, run_test, get_evidence. Status: pre-alpha, under development — STATUS.md says what works today. Re-check every claim with one file: the release asset sovring-suite.pyz (https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/releases/latest/download/sovring-suite.pyz; `python3 sovring-suite.pyz --run <repo>`).

## Umbrella
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/main/README.md)

## Engines
- [armilla-astrolabe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/AGENTS.md): Carry-free residue-number-system engine on ordinary CPUs: exact integer arithmetic on coprime prime rings, with a ternary pull engine, an exact training step and RNS modular exponentiation. Quick test: `PYTHONPATH=engine python3 -m pytest -q engine/tests`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/suite.json)
- [omni-ring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/AGENTS.md): Residue hyperdimensional computing engine: coprime-ring (CRT) memory with a check ring, resonator decode, two-faced ternary/phase hypervector slot, AVX2 C kernel, shards and a shared-memory bus. Quick test: `./build_kernel.sh && python3 -m pytest -q`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/suite.json)
- [vsa-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/AGENTS.md): Ternary vector-symbolic kernel (10,240-dim, two bitplanes) and a POSIX shared-memory blackboard with a seqlock, AVX2 SIMD, phase kernel and trust classifier; C/C++ with a Python client. Quick test: `make -s && python3 xlang_test.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/suite.json)

## Agent tooling
- [tarsus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/AGENTS.md): Safe hands for tool-calling agents: batch tool execution with payload repair, a deterministic safety guard, kernel (Landlock) write confinement, human-only approval, audit trail and an MCP server. Linux only. Quick test: `python3 bin/omnitool_guard.py selftest`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/suite.json)
- [talon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/AGENTS.md): Standalone agent runtime and role-shell terminal: talon run/serve, multi-provider lanes, tool loop, session store. Quick test: `make test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/suite.json)
- [agent-reliability-kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/AGENTS.md): Deterministic dispatch routing, a Rust done-gate that demands physical proof of completion, and research grounding for agent briefs. Quick test: `PYTHONPATH=.:bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/suite.json)
- [cost-savers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/AGENTS.md): Six OpenCode plugins and four CLI tools that cut what coding agents send to paid models, with a pre-registered paired A/B. Quick test: `make test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/suite.json)
- [dock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/AGENTS.md): One MCP server for any number of MCP servers: clients see two tools (search_tools, call_tool) at a constant token cost, and tool search abstains when nothing is relevant. Zero dependencies. Quick test: `npm test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/suite.json)
- [omnid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/AGENTS.md): One small C++ server for local embeddings (nomic-embed-text v1.5 and BitNet-embedding-270M on llama.cpp), a hardened local web face and an MCP face. Models and the bitnet.cpp tree are not shipped. Quick test: `BITNET_DIR=~/projects/bitnet ./build.sh && python3 -m pytest -q tests`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/PROVENANCE.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/suite.json)

## Browser
- [omni-render](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/AGENTS.md): Our own web rendering engine in Rust: packed DOM, own CSS engine, integer layout, 2-bit raster, a program runtime that emits x86, a JavaScript interpreter on its own IR, and a self-repair core for layout. Quick test: `cargo test --release`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/suite.json)
- [omni-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/AGENTS.md): Native apps and a light-use web browser (Omni Web) drawn by the omni-render engine: one packed widget tree is both drawn and read by assistive technology, and a broker plus one confined process per page. Quick test: `cargo build --release && python3 tests/verify_calendar.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/suite.json)

## Research
- [omniring-research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/AGENTS.md): Public research corpus of the OMNIRING project: numbered disclosure chapters, pre-registered ring-resonator experiments (PASS and KILL both published) with their numpy harnesses and run logs, and a status disclosure that marks each later result Measured or NOT YET TESTED. Quick test: `python3 harness/ring1/run_halo.py --quick`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/README.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/suite.json)
